shared_elements: schematic human with arms held out from the body
circular/disc motif (relief roundel on A; rounded head/spots in B)
linear geometric elements incised/drawn on the surface
justification: Both surfaces present frontal, schematic anthropomorphic figures with arms held away from the body, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. A is a single monumental figure whose torso carries relief motifs (a large concentric disc, bands, chevrons) and no interaction, whereas B shows two differently sized stick-like figures in a scene, the larger brandishing a long spear overhead, with no body ornament; the depicted content, relationships and drawing conventions otherwise diverge.
